scope: Ki Blast Super catalog — Festival, Crystal Raid, and cast-exclusive skills

records.name: Galaxy Breaker (Festival)
records.unlock_method: Festival of Universes - Max Camaraderie with Vegeta

records.name: God Bind (Festival)
records.unlock_method: Festival of Universes - Max Camaraderie with Goku (Super Saiyan God)
records.effect: Close-range fire-like Ki prison that stun-locks the opponent before a follow-up palm strike and Ki blast.

records.name: Justice Crush (Festival)
records.unlock_method: Festival of Universes - Max Camaraderie with Dyspo
records.effect: Chargeable long-range Ki blast; maximum charge can warp to the opponent while Dyspo is in Supersonic Mode.

records.name: Gigantic Ki Blast
records.character_source: Expert Mission supervillains / Crystal Raid bosses
records.unlock_method: Expert Mission 18 / Raid or Crystal Raid availability
records.effect: Massive Ki blast; the boss version can be pushed back by Ki blasts and stamina pressure, while the player/Crystal Raid version is a Ki Super and cannot be countered.

records.name: Peeler Storm
records.character_source: Hercule-Gi 2 / Mira (Final Form) / Crystal Raid bosses
records.unlock_method: Expert Mission 20 / Raid or Crystal Raid availability
records.effect: Vanishes on activation and emits slicing shockwaves around the user; player version is also classified as an evasive.

records.name: Marbling Drop
records.effect: Fires many blue blasts around the user that can break the stamina of targets hit.

records.name: Flames of Retribution
records.effect: Short-range explosive wave; the Super and Evasive implementations share the same visual behavior and knockback.

records.name: Seasoning Arrow
records.effect: Purple Ki beams rain around Demigra; hits deal damage and paralyze the opponent.

reconciliation_note: These nine entries were absent from docs/data/skills.json. They are intentionally represented as Super/Ki Blast even when a move also has an Evasive implementation or is restricted to Festival, Crystal Raid, Expert Mission, or cast use. No CaC availability was inferred from category membership. Peeler Storm's dual Super/Evasive behavior and Flames of Retribution's dual classification are preserved in notes/fields rather than changing the canonical identity.
